name: AWL Agri Business Ltd
title: AWL Agri Business Ltd - 543458 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volume +14% to ~1.9mt and EBITDA/t near INR 3,400, but management flags Q1 cost inflation from crude-linked inputs and softer April demand; food guided EBITDA-neutral to FY27.

triggers.label: April demand sluggish, Q1 to pick up
triggers.quote: we see not a very encouraging demand scenario as far as April is concerned

triggers.label: Packing and chemical costs rising into Q1
triggers.quote: all this will get reflected in the Q1 number because the real cost, which has gone up will actually hit

triggers.label: Food EBITDA-neutral to FY27, volume priority
triggers.quote: food will remain an EBITDA neutral till FY '27

triggers.label: Edible oil complex up ~10% passed on
triggers.quote: the edible oil complex went up in the month of March, close to 10%

guidance.quote: we would certainly want in FY '27 food volumes to grow in double digit, at least in mid-teens kind of number
you can build around INR 3,600 a ton or INR3,500 for a safer side

guidance.metric: Food EBITDA per ton from FY28
guidance.quote: build INR1,500 per ton to INR2,000 a ton kind of EBITDA in the food from FY '28
food will remain an EBITDA neutral till FY '27

red_flags.label: Food volume growth flat-ish; margins reinvested
red_flags.quote: we will continue to drive food aggressively and see to it that we get the top line first

red_flags.label: April demand slowdown
red_flags.quote: we see not a very encouraging demand scenario as far as April is concerned

evasions.quote: it's difficult to say up to what volume you would be profitable up to
investors will understand that potential and will give a valuation that we deserve
